purpose.en: Practise balance and hip flexion at a low load.

text.zh: 身体站直，交替慢慢抬膝再放下
text.en: Stand tall and slowly lift one knee, then the other

text.zh: 双手扶稳高背椅，椅子不能滑动
text.en: Hold a sturdy high-backed chair that will not slide.

text.zh: 膝盖抬到舒适高度，控制着放回
text.en: Lift to a comfortable height and lower with control.

commonErrors.en: Leaning back or to the side.

cautions.zh: 扶稳无轮的椅子，疼痛或站不稳时就停止
cautions.en: Hold a stable chair without wheels, and stop if it hurts or you feel unsteady.
